1.web: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
1.asv: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

2.web: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
2.asv: through whom also we have had our access by faith into this grace wherein we stand; and we rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

3.web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance;
3.asv: And not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness;

4.web: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:
4.asv: and stedfastness, approvedness; and approvedness, hope:

5.web: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
5.asv: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of God hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given unto us.

6.web: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
6.asv: For while we were yet weak, in due season Christ died for the ungodly.

7.web: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.
7.asv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: for peradventure for the good man some one would even dare to die.

8.web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
8.asv: But God commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

9.web: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
9.asv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, shall we be saved from the wrath of God through him.

10.web: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
10.asv: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, shall we be saved by his life;

11.web: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
11.asv: and not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

12.web: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.
12.asv: Therefore, as through one man sin entered into the world, and death through sin; and so death passed unto all men, for that all sinned:—

13.web: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
13.asv: for until the law sin was in the world; but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

14.web: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
14.asv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the likeness of Adam’s transgression, who is a figure of him that was to come.

15.web: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
15.asv: But not as the trespass, so also is the free gift. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound unto the many.

16.web: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.
16.asv: And not as through one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment came of one unto condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses unto justification.

17.web: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
17.asv: For if, by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; much more shall they that receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, even Jesus Christ.

18.web: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
18.asv: So then as through one trespass the judgment came unto all men to condemnation; even so through one act of righteousness the free gift came unto all men to justification of life.

19.web: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
19.asv: For as through the one man’s disobedience the many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one shall the many be made righteous.

20.web: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
20.asv: And the law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace did abound more exceedingly:

21.web: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
21.asv: that, as sin reigned in death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
